title: TEDx Q&A
description: Accessible, animated Q&A Accordion component following shadcn / Base UI specifications.

default.question: What is TEDxRegensburg?
default.answer: TEDxRegensburg is a locally and independently organized event that brings people together to share a TED-like experience. Our event features inspiring live speakers and thought-provoking discussions.

default.question: When and where does the event take place?
default.answer: Please check the Venue and Timetable sections on our event page for the exact date, time, and address details.

default.question: Are food and drinks included with the ticket?
default.answer: Yes! Pinsa, snacks, and refreshing beverages are provided before and after the event as well as during the breaks for all ticket holders.

default.question: Can I get a refund if I cannot attend?
default.answer: Tickets are generally transferable to another person. If you need assistance with ticket transfers or refunds, please reach out to our team via the contact form.
